variant.name: baseline
variant.description: serial accumulation chain (15 adders in series), timing-critical baseline

sta.hold_note: nextpnr's ECP5 flow performs max-delay (setup) analysis only; it reports no hold requirement, so no hold slack is claimed here. Min-delay arrival values are available in the raw report for inspection.
conclusions: $glbnet$clk$TRELLIS_IO_IN: VIOLATED - worst path 19.619 ns needs 10.000 ns, so setup slack is -9.619 ns at 100.000 MHz (achievable 50.971 MHz).
Critical path u_core.sr[6] -> u_core.dout is 19.619 ns over 77 steps: 7.825 ns logic (39.9%), 11.269 ns routing (57.4%), 0.525 ns clk-to-q.
Routing dominates the critical path, so this is a placement/congestion problem as much as a logic-depth problem.
Worst net by arrival is u_core.sum_pre at 19.619 ns (6 sink(s)); the slowest nets are the ones to shorten first.
Worst capture point is u_core.dout at 19.619 ns over 74 timed pin(s).
